main.description: Send a one-time code by SMS to verify the viewer's phone number. A number can belong to one account only; a number another account holds gets the same answer but no SMS, and verifyCode reports PhoneTaken. Every request counts against the rate limits. Requires service auth for the rewards service.

phone.description: In E.164 form (+84912345678). Vietnamese numbers may also be written 0912345678.

errors.name: InvalidPhone
errors.description: Not a phone number in E.164 form.

errors.name: PhoneNotSupported
errors.description: Numbers of this country cannot be verified here.

errors.name: PhoneUnavailable
errors.description: Phone verification is not set up on this service.

errors.name: SmsFailed
errors.description: The SMS could not be sent; try again later.
